title: Workplan
subtitle: Activities against the harvest seasons, holidays and report dates: when, with whom, where.

import.title: Import from Excel
import.description: Pick your workplan file: one activity per row, or a Gantt sheet with month columns.
import.reading: Reading the file and matching the columns…
import.pick: Choose an Excel or CSV file
import.pickHint: You can drop the file here. The file is not kept; only the activities are imported.

tips.columns: Code, activity, partner, province, start and end columns are recognised on their own; you can change any column.
tips.grid: An X or a coloured cell in month or quarter columns becomes the date range. Heading rows such as "Output 1" become outputs.
tips.ai: The column headers and the first five rows go to Claude so it can suggest the mapping. Your mapping is remembered for files with the same columns.
tips.noAi: AI is not connected; the mapping comes from the column headers.

import.periodColumns: {count} month or quarter columns ({from} … {to}) become date ranges from the marked cells.
import.found: Found {activities, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}} and {outputs, plural, one {# output heading} other {# output headings}}
import.createOutputs: Add missing outputs to the logframe
import.updateExisting: Update activities with the same code
import.import: Import {count, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}}
import.created: {count, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}} added
import.updated: {count, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}} updated
import.skipped: {count} already existed and were left as they are
import.outputsCreated: {count, plural, one {# output} other {# outputs}} added to the logframe
import.unmatched: Partner names with no match: {list}. Add them under Partners and import the file again.
import.warnings: Notes for {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}

flags.lateDays: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} past its end date
flags.atRisk: At risk: what it waits for is late or ends after it starts

timeline.label: Activity
timeline.dragHint: Drag to move, drag an edge to resize. Arrow keys move a day, Shift a week; Alt changes the end.
timeline.placeHint: Click a day on the line to give it dates
timeline.movedWith: {code} moved: {range} · {count, plural, one {# waiting activity} other {# waiting activities}} moved too

table.title: Activity
table.workdays: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}

sheet.calendarDays: {count, plural, one {# calendar day} other {# calendar days}}
sheet.milestoneHint: A single date: a signature, a delivery, an opening.
sheet.season: Falls in the same period as {name} ({range}).
sheet.holidays: {count, plural, one {# public holiday} other {# public holiday days}} in these dates: {names}.
sheet.descriptionPlaceholder: Purpose, method, number of participants (totals only), notes
sheet.noDependencies: Does not wait for another activity.
sheet.noTasks: No tasks linked to this activity.
sheet.taskPlaceholder: Add a task, for example the ToR draft
sheet.dragTip: Drag the bar on the timeline to change the dates. An activity that waits for it moves only if they would overlap; a planned gap stays.

form.title: New activity
form.description: A code and a name are enough; you can give it dates on the timeline later.
form.name: Activity name

seasonsDialog.title: Seasons
seasonsDialog.description: Harvest periods behind the timeline, so activity timing reads against the season.
seasonsDialog.empty: No seasons yet. Add a ready-made one or draw your own.
seasonsDialog.presetsHint: Dates are averages; adjust them to the province.
seasonsDialog.name: Name

holidaysDialog.title: Holidays
holidaysDialog.description: Public and religious holidays are left out of working days and marked on the timeline.
holidaysDialog.name: Holiday name
holidaysDialog.note: Religious holiday dates for later years are estimates; check them against the Diyanet calendar.

ai.prepDone: Claude suggested {tasks} preparation tasks for {count, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}}. Pick them on the cards.
ai.nothing: No activity in the next six weeks needs preparation.

empty.title: The workplan is empty
empty.body: Import your workplan from Excel or add activities one by one. Add the harvest seasons too; activity timing reads against them.
